rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CVII Of the Manners of the Native or Child
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A distinct printed natal chapter addresses supposed character traits and mental dispositions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed CVII/editorial sequential CVIII, not the preceding four-humours tally.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: manners and motions of the mind
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says conduct and mind are related to temperament and inclinations.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical theory not empirical personality measurement.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: principal humane actions and events of life
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He extends the proposed influence to human actions and life events.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No prospective, independently documented outcomes here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: accidents of mind two-fold rational others sensitive
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He divides mental circumstances into rational and non-rational/sensitive categories.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical philosophy and language, not neuroscience.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: generall rules discovering qualities of mind
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author starts a procedure for selecting planetary significators of manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source procedure only, with flexible chart features.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet occupy Sign ascending or intercepted
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A planet in the rising or intercepted Ascendant sign is principal significator of manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Physical positioning requires chart and house definition.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: other Planet dignities in place of significator
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Planets with dignity where that significator lies also participate.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An additional candidate set, not a unique hard label.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: consider Significator and his Dispositor
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Examine the selected significator and its dispositor together.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A second planet affects the same outcome.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planet strong aspect such
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Strong benefic significator, or one harmoniously configured with benefics, allegedly suggests admirable manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical positive association only.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: malevolent or hostile beams impotent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Weak significator afflicted by a malefic or adverse aspect allegedly indicates immoral/corrupt manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Severe historical moral attribution, not factual person labeling.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benefic by nature but weak shows good outward inward obscure
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A benefic but weak significator may suggest good-looking outward behavior with less favorable interior.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Allows contrasting appearances versus inner character.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortunes potent ... tincture of poison
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Strong malefics are allowed some desirable characteristics while allegedly retaining a malign element.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not a categorical all-bad personality designation.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: which I have ever found true
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly claims this mixed malefic reading always matched his experience.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Author anecdotal certainty without counts or independent record.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury affords manners according Planet assumes
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is said to take the disposition of associated planets.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Symbolic mind significator, not validated behavioral mechanism.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury joined by conjunction to any Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If Mercury is conjunct a planet, take qualities of the conjunct planet.
rules.original_source_qualifications: First choice before dignities-only branch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if with many nearest conjunction and most fortified
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If Mercury conjunct multiple planets, use the nearest or most dignified among them.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Two criteria may disagree; precise tie-break left ambiguous.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if Mercury not conjunct ... essential dignity where placed
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If Mercury lacks conjunction, take the planet strongest by essential dignity at Mercury's own degree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Alternative ranking branch.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: North node as Jupiter
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source analogizes ascending node to Jupiter.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Period signification not modern astronomical causality.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: South node as Saturn and Mars
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source analogizes descending node to Saturn and Mars.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Negative role in later conditional readings.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Luminaries in Horoscope ... generally small unless strong
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Sun/Moon in the Ascendant are said to matter little to manners unless unusually strong.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Important exception to simple luminary-in-first claims.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many Planets in Horoscope variety of manners
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Several planets in the Ascendant are interpreted as a mixture of manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No single fixed trait across contexts.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: most powerful Planet most durable
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The most powerful among the Ascendant occupants allegedly indicates the most enduring traits.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Dominance depends on choice of strength metric.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: how long by Directions
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly proposes determining trait duration through astrological directions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A potentially flexible time dimension, not validated life-course prediction.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: for when Moon is directed
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The direction rule continues over the original PDF569→570 page seam.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One continuous argument, not duplicate outcome.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon directed to term or aspect most potent Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon reaching the terms or aspects of a powerful planet supposedly accentuates that planet's attributed manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Timing requires direction calculation not provided here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon varies term or aspect manners vary
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When lunar direction reaches a different planet's term or aspect, manners supposedly change.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not a fixed lifelong chart-class description.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon to Venus cheerful
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Venus term/aspect is associated with cheerful behavior.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical subjective attribution.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon to Jupiter discreet modest religious
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Jupiter term/aspect is associated with discretion, modesty and religiosity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical subjective attribution.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon to Mars angry quarrelsome
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars term/aspect is associated with anger and contentiousness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Negative historical stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon to Saturn grave melancholy fearful laborious
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn term/aspect is associated with seriousness, melancholy, fear and laboriousness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historic psychological/medical categories, not diagnoses.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: no planet in ascendant ... joined to Moon or Mercury
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If Ascendant contains no planet, first consider the planet joined to Moon or Mercury.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different starting condition from planet in first.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: joined to Moon and Mercury both
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When a planet contacts both Moon and Mercury, treat the result like several planets in the horoscope.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Can suggest discrepant or mixed traits.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: most powerful continues longest
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The stronger such planet is said to supply longer-lasting manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Duration not quantitatively defined.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: no planet in ascendant or joined to Mercury or Luna ... Lord Ascendant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If neither a planet in first nor conjunction with Mercury/Moon, take the Ascendant ruler.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Third-tier fallback.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Ascendant judged by nature good or ill
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Evaluate the ruling planet's nature and condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Benefic/malefic values subjective by modern standards.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: his Dispositor behold him with some aspect
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Include an aspect of the Ascendant ruler's dispositor.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Further branch and additional planet.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if no Planet aspect ... strongly affects Luna/Mercury
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: If the Ascendant ruler receives no aspect, consider the planet most strongly aspecting Moon or Mercury.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Another chosen candidate under different eligibility.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: none partill aspect ... most essential dignities Moon and Mercury degrees
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: With no partile aspects to Moon/Mercury, choose the planet with most essential dignity at their degrees.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Last-resort ranking; can shift winner given many configurations.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: partill aspect
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The fallback specifically mentions partile aspects, implying tighter precision than generic aspects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Partile numerical orb not provided on this page.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: fixed Stars first or second magnitude little distant Ecliptick
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly attaches special importance to first/second-magnitude fixed stars near the ecliptic.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The 1647 coordinates require epoch/precession adjustments; no independently demonstrated character influence.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significator of Manners joined to fixed Stars
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The strong association is specifically tied to the selected manners significator being close or conjunct a star.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Proximity orb is not numerically fixed.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: make those signified more apparent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He claims these stars magnify the indicated manners.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source assertion, no blinded behavioral outcomes.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Caput Medusae 21 Taurus dogged violence sudden death
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Conjunction with Algol/Caput Medusae allegedly produces violence and can even cause death to self or others.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Unverified, highly stigmatizing and dangerous moral/criminal prediction; never apply to real people.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Pleiades 24 Taurus wanton ambitious turbulent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Pleiades allegedly indicate wantonness, ambition and turbulence.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not an evidence-based character assessment.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Oculus Taurus 4 30 Gemini fierce courage
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Oculus Tauri example about courage and martial agitation begins at page570 bottom and continues PDF571.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate continuous star example rather than duplicated case.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon conjunction this star good fellow
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly qualifies the violent reading if Moon is conjunct the specified star.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The qualification changes claimed polarity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Ascendant conjunction star ... more probable murder
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says conjunction with Ascendant ruler plus further afflictions makes a severe accusation more likely.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Alleged criminal propensity is NOT evidence, never assign it to a living person.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Oculus Taurus gives afflictions wicked
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He describes Saturn in this star position as affliction and a negative mental outcome.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historic severe stigmatizing belief, not psychiatry.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Little Goat 16 30 Gemini curiosity novelty fear
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A star called Little Goat allegedly suggests curiosity mixed with carefulness and fearfulness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historic association only.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Orion Girdle 17 20 Gemini memory industry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Orion's belt allegedly improves understanding and memory, encouraging industry.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No measured cognition outcomes.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lesser Dog about 9 Cancer boastful anger violent giddy
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A lesser Dog star allegedly suggests pride, anger and careless violence.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Hercules 18 Cancer cunning courage cruelty
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Hercules allegedly signifies craft, spirited audacity and cruelty.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Basilisk Lions Heart 24 Leo rule ambition generosity
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The star called Basilisk/Heart of Lion allegedly suggests generosity, magnanimity and desire for dominion.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Occurs on conjunction with significator or Asc ruler.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Scorpion Heart 4 30 Sagittarius obstinate rash
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Scorpion's Heart allegedly suggests rashness and obstinacy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No empirical criminal or behavioral basis.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Virgin Spike 18 Libra good arts sciences
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Spica/Spike of the Virgin allegedly associates with learning, artistic invention and pleasant disposition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different sign from the name 'Virgin'; keep original sign Libra.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Spica with Mercury invention
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says Mercury conjunction with Spica especially suggests invention and arts.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An additional planetary modifier.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Spica with Saturn suspicious harsh violent
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: With Saturn he instead describes suspicion, harshness and dispute.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Explicit reversal relative to positive baseline star reading.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Spica with Mars rigid fool
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: With Mars he assigns rigidity or deficient judgment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Another negative exception; not mental-health proof.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lyra 10 Capricorn sobriety but outward pretense
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lyra allegedly suggests seriousness/sobriety but the author alleges insincerity or sensuality.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source permits apparently contradictory features.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Aquila 26 Capricorn brave violent bloodshed
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Aquila allegedly suggests confidence alongside severe aggression.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Unverified criminal/violent stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Rictus 1 Aquarius with Mercury foolish or acute
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: With Mercury Rictus can allegedly indicate either foolishness or acute understanding.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Same placement receives opposing outcomes; poorly falsifiable.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: planet conjunction fixed star necessary
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The conditions in many star examples refer to conjunction of significator or Asc ruler rather than any nearby star.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Do not score all stars regardless of chart contact.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Dolphin Aquarius 9 to15 cheerful sport but deceit
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Dolphin allegedly suggests delight in outdoor sport and an inconsistent/double-dealing manner.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source claims apparent good and bad in one label.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Tail of Swan beginning Pisces ingenuity learning
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Tail of the Swan allegedly indicates quick learning and ingenuity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historic cognition claim not validated.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Johannes Angelus around 1494 Venice print
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly refers to Johannes Angelus printing a manners-by-ascending-degree book around 1494.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original Angelus text not independently audited here.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Angelus little too strict
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly considers Angelus's precise degree-by-degree stereotypes too rigid.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Important authorial rejection of an overfitted fine-grained model.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: relate what I find generally delivered
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He prefers giving a more general list of zodiac/sign-based character attributions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Coarser but still unverified categorical source.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Aries witty ingenious
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Aries is associated with wit and ingenuity.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Traditional generalization, no independent human test.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Taurus laborious
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Taurus is associated with diligence or laboriousness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Traditional generalization.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Gemini witty deceitful lover Arts
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Gemini is associated with intelligence/arts along with deceit.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Mixed positive and negative source traits.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Cancer inconstant variable never fixed
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Cancer is associated with changeability.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Broad vague source characterization.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Leo grave sober discreet a little cruel
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Leo is associated with sobriety/discretion and some cruelty.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Broad source characterization.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Virgo Arts learning covetous war
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Virgo is associated with learning and ambition, alongside harsh/covetousness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Mixed source characterization.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Libra inconstant crafty condemns arts
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Libra is associated with craftiness, changing mind and criticism of arts.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Scorpio brasse-face understanding arrogant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Scorpio is associated with impudence, ambition and good understanding.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sagittarius valiant fearless
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Sagittarius is associated with courage.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source stereotype.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Capricorn lecherous not constant
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Capricorn is accused of sexual inconstancy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Stigmatizing sexual-history inference unsupported by evidence.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Aquarius humane affable religion
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Aquarius is associated with friendliness and religious constancy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical value-laden trait.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Pisces stammering fraudulent hypocrite
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Pisces is accused of stammering, deceit or hypocrisy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Stigmatizing speech/character stereotype; not evidence of any individual.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sanguine cheerful liberal faithful peace makers
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly attaches cheerfulness, sociability and peacefulness to sanguine.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical category, not verified psychological assessment.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Cholerick angry quarrelsome revenge ambitious
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Choleric is associated with anger, quarrelsomeness, revenge and ambition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical stereotype; source also allows ingenuity.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Melanchollick cautious private sorrow fearful
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Melancholic is associated with slowness, reserve, prudence, suspicion and fear.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not psychiatric diagnostic criteria.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Phlegmatick mutable timid sluggards
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Phlegmatic is described as changeable, timid or slow to act.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Stigmatizing humoral generalization.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CVIII quality of Manners discerned from every Planet
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A different following chapter begins below the divider on original PDF573/printed539.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Sequential editorial CIX, separate source lane.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn strong well affected versus weak unfortunate
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: It contrasts planetary strength and weakness with different putative personality descriptions.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Navigation-only, not part of the sign/fixed-star manners chapter.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: planet traits continued next page
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The new chapter continues on original PDF574–575 with planet-specific strong/weak tables.
rules.original_source_qualifications: New source needs a separate complete scan audit.
